preflight.config_contents:
# Local workstream build policy for the disk-constrained shared target.
# Built-in commands: cargo --config <absolute-path> test/build/check ...
# External Clippy wrapper: cargo clippy --config <absolute-path> ...
# Placing --config before clippy drops it before the wrapper Cargo child.
# Only backend debug information and incremental caching change.
# Optimization, debug assertions, overflow checks, dependencies and test scope
# retain their manifest/profile defaults. This file does not change releases.

[profile.dev.package.nyxid]
debug = 0
incremental = false

[profile.test.package.nyxid]
debug = 0
incremental = false
